requirements.criterion: Shared Settings surfaces, typography, selection, icons and spacing. One shared Apps/Rotate/Layout action row; Start/Stop in status; Save/Reset/Scroll in Settings > App settings; phone Scroll left, centered Touchpad/Info group and Back right header with 48 dp targets and isolated gestures. Status defaults collapsed, remembers a shared expansion preference, preserves main actions and exceptional recovery/confirmation/protection controls. No triple-dot status shortcut; leading-aligned Show details/Hide details text beneath the monitor summary, no chevron or separate disclosure row/button; status body provides a 48dp minimum disclosure target, independent of child actions, with keyboard/accessibility expansion state. Normal collapsed height at most 80dp; enlarged text may grow. Start/Stop uses a plain white icon, transparent resting background, no circle/border and bounded ripple with an independent 48dp target. All menu headers on phone/monitor use plain white 24dp Back/Settings/Close icons with transparent resting fill, no circle/border, bounded feedback and independent accessible 48dp targets; titles retain 8dp horizontal padding and one-line end ellipsis without changing navigation.

requirements.criterion: Stop releases the desktop; reopening or launching starts it and reports connection state. Activity-host startup is bounded, cleans up on missing attachment and rejects late hosts/stale deadlines. Rejected foreground-service setup clears state and supports retry without escaping the main callback. Launcher reopening reuses the bound controller and retries startup; pending-request resume recovers, while focus restoration after explicit Stop remains stopped. Explicit Stop restores the existing display-0 controller after single/split cleanup and the resulting native window/input transition, including slow cleanup, without restarting; newer generations or released/replaced live controller owners invalidate restoration. Passive teardown does not foreground it; no absent controller or unrelated task is created/closed. Failed final input/display cleanup or unconfirmed task migration in either pane suppresses restoration and reports cleanup uncertainty/reopen guidance without overwriting newer session status. An app-close warning may fall back to confirmed display/task release. Chrome single-view Stop retains controller focus for 15 seconds without menu input or a fresh controller launch, including reused Chrome tasks and late app resume requests. Native Chrome acceptance runs outside app instrumentation; shell return may focus only the captured sole display-0 MainActivity task after cleanup, and refuses arbitrary tasks or a restarted helper desktop. Native phone action selection is display-0/package scoped, rejects ambiguous or occluded targets, finishes read-only shell helper cleanup before one explicit tap, allows bounded fresh-snapshot polling only for absent actions while retaining every attempt and refusing unsafe targets/timeouts, never retries native input, and makes no helper/input/focus call after Stop.
requirements.gap: Current Samsung Android 16 corrected APK bf5e572 passes three native Chrome Stop cycles, each with 15 idle seconds of display-0 controller focus and no owned desktop, in 20261017T144958.866907Z-chrome-stop. Current consolidated input/UI/idle/split checks separately cover cleanup, scope refusal, newer-session/live-owner invalidation, passive teardown, injected faults and four monitor rotations. Android 11 current full monitor run 20261017T145640.141526Z and native run 20261017T151018.648476Z-chrome-stop also pass three 15-second cycles; earlier JoyUI native cycles/negative comparison are historical.
